# sophosfirewall Provider

The **Sophos Firewall** provider manages Sophos Firewall (SFOS) configuration through the Firewall Configuration REST API (`/api/firewall-config/v1`).

**Requires SFOS v23.0 or later.** Create an API key under *Administration > API access* in the web admin console.

Provider versions `23.x` and later are a rewrite for the REST API and are not compatible with configurations written for `1.x`, which used the legacy XML API with a username and password. Pin `version = "~> 1.0"` to stay on the old provider.

> **Note:** This is not an official Sophos Firewall (SFOS) provider. It is developed independently and has been tested in a limited capacity. Try changes on a non-production firewall first.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    sophosfirewall = {
      source  = "jubinaghara/sophosfirewall"
      version = "~> 23.0"
    }
  }
}

# The endpoint and API key can also come from SFOS_ENDPOINT and SFOS_API_KEY.
provider "sophosfirewall" {
  endpoint = "https://172.16.16.16:4444"
  api_key  = var.sophosfirewall_api_key
  insecure = true # appliance uses its factory self-signed certificate
}

variable "sophosfirewall_api_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `api_key` (String, Sensitive) API key sent as a bearer token. Can also be set with `SFOS_API_KEY`.
- `endpoint` (String) Address of the firewall, e.g. `https://172.16.16.16:4444` or `172.16.16.16:4444`. The API base path is appended automatically. Can also be set with `SFOS_ENDPOINT`.
- `insecure` (Boolean) Skip TLS certificate verification, e.g. for the factory self-signed certificate. Can also be set with `SFOS_INSECURE`. Defaults to `false`.
- `max_retries` (Number) Retries for throttled (429) or temporarily unavailable (502-504) responses. Defaults to `3`.
- `request_timeout` (Number) Timeout of a single API request in seconds. Defaults to `60`.
